cases.name: EGFR T790M — Osimertinib retains/gains
cases.literature: Cross et al., Cancer Discov 2014 — Osimertinib (AZD9291) was specifically designed to retain potency against T790M; cellular IC50 ~1 nM vs T790M, comparable to or better than WT.
cases.caveat: Osimertinib is a covalent acrylamide on C797. Vina is non-covalent — magnitude will be smaller than IC50 shifts suggest, but the geometric T790M preference (the methionine bulk fits the Osimertinib scaffold better than threonine does) still produces a measurable ΔΔG.
cases.verdict_note: |Δ|=0.30 below ±1.0 kcal/mol noise floor — direction not resolvable at exhaustiveness=16

cases.name: BRAF V600E — Vemurafenib selectivity
cases.literature: Bollag et al., Nature 2010 — Vemurafenib (PLX4032) is V600E-selective; ~30 nM against V600E vs ~100 nM against WT BRAF in cellular assays.

cases.name: BTK C481S — Ibrutinib covalent escape
cases.literature: Woyach et al., NEJM 2014 — C481S ablates the covalent cysteine target of Ibrutinib; >100-fold cellular IC50 loss in CLL.
cases.caveat: Ibrutinib's WT advantage is COVALENT (acrylamide → C481 thiol). Vina is non-covalent and will under-represent this effect; the residual non-covalent ΔΔG should still be positive (S is smaller than C, slight pocket reshape) but smaller than IC50 data suggests.
cases.verdict_note: |Δ|=0.50 below ±1.0 kcal/mol noise floor — direction not resolvable at exhaustiveness=16

cases.name: BTK C481S — Pirtobrutinib retention
cases.literature: Mato et al., NEJM 2021 — Pirtobrutinib is non-covalent; retains potency against C481S (cellular IC50 essentially unchanged).
cases.caveat: Pirtobrutinib's clinical retention against C481S comes from being non-covalent — no acrylamide to lose. Rigid-receptor Vina cannot model covalent vs non-covalent mechanism, so Pirtobrutinib and Ibrutinib both return similar small-magnitude ΔΔG against C481S even though their clinical IC50 shifts differ by >100×. Documented limitation, not a pipeline regression.
cases.verdict_note: |Δ|=0.70 within ±1.0 kcal/mol noise floor (retained as expected)
